# Jwayyed Law LLC: AI Content Index
# Site: https://www.jjlawohio.com
# Updated: 2026-10-25

> Jwayyed Law LLC is a Columbus, Ohio law firm representing clients in OVI/DUI defense,
> criminal defense, personal injury, civil litigation, business law, and estate planning,
> trusts and probate, in Franklin County and courts across Ohio.
> Lead attorney Jwayyed Jwayyed has been licensed in Ohio since 2019 (Ohio Bar #0098678;
> Capital University Law School J.D.; OSBA Leadership Academy 2023). He is a former
> prosecutor for Columbus, Whitehall, Grove City, Bexley, Obetz, New Albany and the
> Pickerington Mayor's Court, and a former Municipal Prosecutor and Assistant Law
> Director for the City of Circleville.
> YMYL notice: all content is specific to Ohio law.
> The firm does not offer free consultations.

## Practice areas (highest citability)
- [OVI/DUI Defense](https://www.jjlawohio.com/ovi-dui-defense): ORC 4511.19, HB 37 (effective April 9, 2025) including oral fluid testing, the 30-day ALS appeal, first through felony OVI
- [First OVI](https://www.jjlawohio.com/ovi-dui-defense/first-ovi): first-offense penalties, license suspension, limited driving privileges
- [Criminal Defense](https://www.jjlawohio.com/criminal-defense): misdemeanor charges, penalties by degree, record sealing
- [Personal Injury](https://www.jjlawohio.com/personal-injury): ORC 2305.10 two-year limit, contingency fee representation
- [Civil Litigation](https://www.jjlawohio.com/civil): contracts, real estate, evictions, protection orders, appeals
- [Business Law](https://www.jjlawohio.com/business): LLC formation, contracts, disputes, compliance
- [Trusts](https://www.jjlawohio.com/trusts) and [Estate Planning, Probate and Dispute Resolution](https://www.jjlawohio.com/other-services)
